terminal_phase.name: initial_full_snapshot.apply.current_prices_upsert
terminal_phase.statement_family: apply: insert or update current prices
terminal_phase.statement_text: INSERT INTO current_prices (id, retailer_item_id, store_id, item_price, unit_of_measure_price, allow_discount, source_updated_at, last_sale_at, audit_number, source_file_id, first_observed_at, last_observed_at) SELECT uuidv7(), retailer_item_id, store_id, item_price, unit_of_measure_price, allow_discount, price_updated_at, last_sale_at, audit_number, :source_file_id, :applied_at, :applied_at FROM pg_temp.makolet_mapped_price_incoming incoming ON CONFLICT (retailer_item_id, store_id) DO UPDATE SET item_price = excluded.item_price, unit_of_measure_price = excluded.unit_of_measure_price, allow_discount = excluded.allow_discount, source_updated_at = excluded.source_updated_at, last_sale_at = excluded.last_sale_at, audit_number = excluded.audit_number, source_file_id = excluded.source_file_id, last_observed_at = excluded.last_observed_at

bounded_progress_sample.wal_lsn_probe: pg_current_wal_insert_lsn, pg_current_wal_write_lsn, and pg_current_wal_flush_lsn did not return within 5 seconds
bounded_progress_sample.schema_size_probe: did not return within its hard bound

termination.classification: The backend, checkpointer, and background writer were simultaneously stuck on WAL locks while bounded database, VHD, and physical-disk samples showed no storage progress. This is infrastructure-stall evidence, not a completed application throughput measurement.
termination.root_cause_limit: PostgreSQL logs could not be read because the isolated WSL distro and then the WSL control plane did not recover after termination.
termination.pg_terminate_backend: targeted only backend PID 496 but did not return
termination.benchmark_processes: targeted only the two verified standard database runner processes; runner count reached zero
termination.isolated_distro: normal termination and direct backend TERM did not return; the exact MakoletBenchmark distro host was forcibly stopped after its registry GUID and E:\MakoletBenchmarkWSL path were revalidated

cleanup.details: Two bounded wsl --shutdown calls and the one authorized final wsl --list --verbose recovery check timed out. WSLService could not be restarted without elevation. PostgreSQL crash recovery, log inspection, schema/session/lock verification, baseline-size verification, and credential rotation therefore remain unverified. WSLService and vmcompute were not terminated.

broader_recovery_side_effects.docker_desktop: stopped during safeguarded WSL recovery and not restarted because further WSL/Docker actions were explicitly halted
broader_recovery_side_effects.unrelated_ubuntu_distro: inactive before recovery and never started

acceptance_note: The exact one-million-normalized / ten-million-current standard database scenario did not complete. Database acceptance is false, the enforced plan gate was not reached, and no performance baseline or regression limit may be derived from this cutoff.
unmeasured: standard apply and query plan gate
